predecessors.name: Benin Empire
predecessors.text: the Itsekiri coast, settled by Prince Ginuwa, eldest son of Oba Olua of Benin

successors.name: Niger Coast Protectorate
successors.text: Warri, under a protectorate treaty signed on 16 July 1884

ledger.x: c. 1480: Prince Ginuwa founds the Warri kingdom. The kingdom 'was established in 1480' and 'founded around c. 1480 by Prince Ginuwa, the eldest son of Oba Olua of the Kingdom of Benin'; the migration 'began around 1470 with seventy Benin chiefs', which the page does not reconcile with Olua's accession in 1473.
1884 (16 July): the Warri chiefs sign a British protectorate treaty.
1884 (July): the sovereign kingdom ends; 'In 1894, after a dispute, the Royal Navy defeated Nana Olomu, ending Warri's autonomy'.
